title: Bridge step 13: multi-user host mimid-host
description: The multi-user host, designed once for Marmot puppets and the XMPP gateway of client-survey.md; started only after step 12. Many agent-core Agents in one process, send-only agents, shared pool and scheduler, 500-user cap, RemoteNetwork adapter trait, relay bridge on the host; DELETE /local/v1/users/{user} on mimid-server. See docs/design/marmot-bridge.md (branch bridge-decisions, 1c2b6eba) §3.3.6, §3.3.7, §9 step 13.
